svg.aria-label: Sketch after a Getty Images photograph on CBS New York: the apron at Newark Liberty under a heavy overcast, the lower Manhattan skyline with One World Trade Center along the horizon, a United widebody jet taxiing left past a smaller narrowbody, and in the foreground a white fuel tanker truck with its hose run to the wing of a regional jet parked nose-on at a gate marked 113, a jet bridge with a dark hood attached to its door; no people are in the scene.
